en.headline: 82-year-old man dies after being pulled from water at Wu Kai Sha pier
en.dek: The man, surnamed Chan, was found unconscious by other swimmers around 4pm on Wednesday and was later certified dead at Prince of Wales Hospital; a post-mortem examination is pending.
body: An 82-year-old man died after being pulled from the water at Wu Kai Sha pier in Ma On Shan on Wednesday afternoon, local reports said.

The man, surnamed Chan, was found unconscious by other swimmers at around 4pm and was rushed to Prince of Wales Hospital, where he was later pronounced dead. The cause of death is pending a post-mortem examination.
Police are investigating the circumstances of the incident.

zh.headline: 烏溪沙碼頭82歲男子遇溺不治
zh.dek: 男子周三下午約4時被其他泳客發現昏迷，送往威爾斯親王醫院後證實死亡，死因有待剖驗確定。
body: 一名82歲男子周三下午在馬鞍山烏溪沙碼頭遇溺，其後不治。
姓陳男子約下午4時被其他泳客發現昏迷，送往威爾斯親王醫院後證實死亡。死因有待剖驗確定。
